build_consolidate_sharded_checkpoint: build a consolidated checkpoint from sharded FSDP checkpoint files for model evaluation
create_checkpoint_writer: create a CheckpointWriter to save model checkpoints with consolidated or sharded formats on disk
load_checkpoint_weights: load checkpoint weights into a FullyShardedDataParallel model with slice or consolidated format support
convert_checkpoint_format: convert a checkpoint from sharded or consolidated format to sliced format for memory-efficient FSDP loading
init_model_from_weights: initialize a VISSL model from a pre-trained checkpoint with prefix handling and layer skipping support
